helper_version: A085 endpoint-audit v1; independent character sums, physical edges and Fraction prime-log forms
family: All labelled Boolean signs for n=1,2,3; point defects and complements at the zero vertex for n=4 through 10; one fixed five-bit negative set {5,12,13}
domain: 276 small-cube tables + 14 point-defect fixtures + 1 named five-bit witness = 291 cases; ell=2,3,4 where meaningful; analytic endpoint proof covers every n>=1 and fixed ell>=2
symmetry: No quotient in the exhaustive n<=3 check; larger fixtures are named functions, not a census
arithmetic: Integer direct character sums and physical edge counts; Fraction squared masses; formal prime-log cancellation; positive atanh-series rational intervals only for named witness sign
search: No new maximization search, no automatic dimension escalation; explicitly fixed fixtures
targets: Minimal positive influence endpoint and exact higher-tail supremum; sublinear-cutoff scope is checked analytically, not inferred from finite samples
